issues.title: SecretStorage read exception blocks activation
issues.evidence: secretReadResilience.test.js 3/3; commit ee059dd
issues.acceptance: Slow/failing keyring cannot block first paint; provider errors surface only on provider actions

issues.title: Session selection races and cross-workspace contamination
issues.evidence: activateCoachSessionCommand commits late responses without workspace/session generation re-check
issues.acceptance: A→B selection keeps B; workspace switch during activate never writes A's session into B

issues.title: Provider cross-connection model switch fails without rollback
issues.evidence: providerWebviewCommands switches profile before model validation and returns error without rollback
issues.acceptance: Invalid target keeps profile+model+UI unchanged; error text matches actual state

issues.title: Model refresh failure clears visible catalog
issues.evidence: failed refresh returns availableModels: [] and UI overwrites cached catalog
issues.acceptance: Refresh failure keeps previous catalog visible with refreshed-at + failure state

issues.title: Startup cache not bound to session/empty state
issues.evidence: bootstrapSnapshotCache.test.js 6/6; commit 7262f75
issues.acceptance: Cache restores only matching workspace+session; empty session overwrites/clears stale thread

issues.title: Browser offline queue concurrent updates lose tasks
issues.evidence: background.js read-modify-write races between captures and flush
issues.acceptance: Concurrent captures/flush never lose an accepted task; queue mutations serialized

issues.title: Stale port owned by another window clears queue
issues.evidence: 401 treated as permanent, queue items removed, connection marked ok
issues.acceptance: 401 triggers identity re-discovery or pauses delivery; queue never cleared on auth mismatch

issues.title: Old request delivers captures to new pairing's workspace
issues.evidence: queued items lack pairing/workspace identity; revoke/re-pair does not fence in-flight work
issues.acceptance: Tasks pin workspaceId+pairingId+operationId; stale tasks never deliver to new workspace

issues.title: Accepted selection drafts lost on sidecar restart
issues.evidence: browser_bridge keeps pending drafts in memory only
issues.acceptance: Accepted drafts survive sidecar restart with delivery/application states

issues.title: Old resource mistaken as this download's success
issues.evidence: waitForCapturedResource matches prior captured-from record
issues.acceptance: Operation completion requires this operationId/clientCaptureId result

issues.title: Deleted resource cannot be re-captured
issues.evidence: client-side history duplicate short-circuits before server
issues.acceptance: Deleted resources can be re-captured; server decides existence

issues.title: URL dedup skips docs supplement and focus binding
issues.evidence: server returns early on URL/hash hit before include_docs/focus handling
issues.acceptance: Re-capture with new intent performs supplement/binding and reports real result

issues.title: Unrelated remote test certifies current training card
issues.evidence: remote verification only checks project/authority/hash, not card target relation
issues.acceptance: Verification binds card+files+hashes+runId; unrelated tests cannot mark verified

issues.title: Late attestation overwrites current card selection
issues.evidence: learning route writes selected_card_id without generation check
issues.acceptance: Late results append to history; current selection unchanged

issues.title: Remote verification writes no unified growth evidence
issues.evidence: remote attest writes legacy queue only; training_evidence stays empty
issues.acceptance: Local and remote verification produce the same trusted evidence record

issues.title: Concurrent starts create two active attempts
issues.evidence: attempt_store lookup+insert not atomic; no unique active constraint
issues.acceptance: find-or-create is transactional/unique; duplicates impossible under concurrency

issues.title: Concurrent attempt save loses hint level
issues.evidence: attempt JSON read-modify-write; hint level can regress
issues.acceptance: Field merges preserve concurrent fields; assistance level never regresses

issues.title: Long remote log incremental reads return wrong data
issues.evidence: verificationSessions uses buffer length as offset after truncation
issues.acceptance: Absolute cursor reads work past truncation; truncation is reported

issues.title: Remote run dedup ignores environment variables
issues.evidence: dedup key lacks env; concurrent start can double-launch
issues.acceptance: env+policy in identity; start promise registered before first await

issues.title: Linux browser detection fails on Windows CI

issues.acceptance: Cross-Platform Verify UI (windows) passes on this fix

issues.title: Installed-host E2E not re-run at current SHA

issues.title: Text-only reflection shows irrelevant image-capability warning
